title: Meeting of 22 October 2026: remote-only arrangements, outstanding questions and the Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr) records
outcome: Sent 20 October 2026. Response due by 17 November 2026; WhatDoTheyKnow shows the response as delayed. The Council has sent a reply (11 November) and two holding acknowledgements (17 and 18 November); no full answer to this request's questions is recorded on the thread as at 24 November 2026.

messages.summary: Letter to the Clerk of Llandough Community Council about the remote-only arrangements for the 22 October 2026 meeting, outstanding questions, and the Council's records on Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr).

Update to the public record after the 22 October meeting: draft minutes with the requester's proposed additions (attendance, public participation), and a note about the Council website's expired security certificate.

Requester update: asks the Council to reconcile two statements about whether it holds further Great House Farm records beyond the minute books deposited with Glamorgan Archives in 2002. The 17 November deadline is left open.
Clerk's reply with a Word document attached. The attachment's contents are not summarised here.

messages.summary: Consolidated follow-up on outstanding records; asks for one clear, documented response.
Holding acknowledgement: the councillors will consider the email and reply in the near future.
Outstanding matters in priority order: asks when the councillors will consider the 14 November email, and for status updates on separate requests that keep their original receipt dates.
Holding acknowledgement: the two 17 November emails will be considered by councillors on 19 November 2026 and a response given after that meeting.

Letter to the Clerk, Chair and councillors after the 18 November Full Council meeting: remote-only arrangements, outstanding procedural questions, and the Council's basis for its involvement with the land and the records showing how that position arose.
